---
title: "Gallery"
lightbox: true
---

````{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Each entry in gallery/ holds its settings (config.yml, merged into
# _quartodown/_quartodown.yml, and any files for _quartodown/) and
# screenshots of this site built with them, made by tools/gallery.R.
gallery_entry <- function(name) {
  dir <- file.path("gallery", name)
  images <- sprintf(
    '![](%s/%s.png){.%s-content .border .rounded fig-alt="This site with the %s settings, in %s mode"}',
    dir,
    c("light", "dark"),
    c("light", "dark"),
    name,
    c("light", "dark")
  )
  config <- readLines(file.path(dir, "config.yml"))
  files <- setdiff(list.files(dir), c("config.yml", "light.png", "dark.png"))
  blocks <- c(
    if (!all(startsWith(config, "#"))) {
      code_block("_quartodown/_quartodown.yml", "yaml", config)
    },
    unlist(lapply(files, function(file) {
      code_block(
        file.path("_quartodown", file),
        tools::file_ext(file),
        readLines(file.path(dir, file))
      )
    }))
  )
  cat(images, sep = "\n\n")
  if (length(blocks) > 0) {
    cat(
      "",
      "::: {.callout-note collapse=\"true\"}",
      "## The settings",
      "",
      blocks,
      ":::",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  }
}

code_block <- function(file, lang, lines) {
  c(paste0("`", file, "`:"), "", paste0("```", lang), lines, "```", "")
}
````

This site uses quartodown's defaults. Each screenshot below shows the same site
built with the settings under it; click one to enlarge it. The screenshots
follow your light or dark mode. See [Customizing your site](../customizing.qmd)
for every setting.

## The default

Quarto's `default` theme in light mode and `darkly` in dark mode, with the
navbar at the top.

```{r}
#| label: gallery-default
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

gallery_entry("default")
```

## A built-in theme

`theme:` picks any of Quarto's [built-in
themes](https://quarto.org/docs/output-formats/html-themes.html), here `cosmo`
in light mode and `superhero` in dark mode. A theme can also be your own `.scss`
file in `_quartodown/`.

```{r}
#| label: gallery-theme
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

gallery_entry("theme")
```

## A sidebar

`navbar: style: sidebar` moves the navigation into a sidebar beside every page,
which also lists every reference page.

```{r}
#| label: gallery-sidebar
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

gallery_entry("sidebar")
```

## A custom look

`_quartodown/extra.scss` restyles any part of the site, on top of the theme:
here a navbar in the accent color, serif headings, rounder code blocks and the
function reference as cards.

```{r}
#| label: gallery-custom
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

gallery_entry("custom")
```
